task: Create an office floor plan at /home/user/Documents/floorplan.drawio. Create 6 rectangles labeled: Lobby, MeetingRoom, Office1, Office2, Kitchen, Restroom. Apply fills: Lobby #f5f5f5, MeetingRoom #dae8fc, Kitchen #fff2cc. Connect adjacent rooms with at least 5 edges representing doorways: Lobby<->MeetingRoom, Lobby<->Office1, Lobby<->Office2, Lobby<->Kitchen, Kitchen<->Restroom. Save the file.

verification.description: At least 5 doorway edges on page 0

verification.prompt: Inspect the vertices list. Does the vertex labeled 'Lobby' have fillColor=#f5f5f5 in its style, the vertex labeled 'MeetingRoom' have fillColor=#dae8fc, and the vertex labeled 'Kitchen' have fillColor=#fff2cc? All three must match.
